channel.title: UseMac Changelog
channel.description: Official automatic updates for UseMac (macOS 15+ Apple Silicon).

item.title: Version 0.8.0-beta.1
item.description:
What's New in UseMac 0.8.0 Beta 1

  • The on-device vision model is optional: most tasks don't need it, so Apple Vision OCR reads the screen until you install a model and turn it on. A model you turn on loads the first time a task needs it, unloads after 5 idle minutes, and one copy is shared by every agent.
  • Element and full-page screenshots no longer make Chrome enlarge the page: it scrolls while it is captured and goes back to where it was. Full pages can be up to 16384 px tall.
  • UseMac notices when its safety settings are changed outside it, including the app and site rules and Record typed text. It then starts Paused with safe defaults and tells you, and only you resume.
  • The first launch of this version turns Debug capture and Record typed text off. Turn them on again in Settings if you use them.

After updating, reload the UseMac Browser Bridge from Settings → Chrome Extension.

This is a beta. Please report problems at github.com/diegosquid/usemac/issues, or ask your agent to prepare a report.

item.title: Version 0.7.0-beta.1
item.description:
What's New in UseMac 0.7.0 Beta 1

  • A live preview that moves on its own: with several agents at once, their cards stack behind the front one and take turns in front every few seconds. Hover the preview to hold the current card.
  • Each task has its own soft color tag in the preview, so two sessions of the same agent are easy to tell apart.
  • The preview keeps one size: the page fills it from the top-left corner and the rest is cut off.
  • Agents never resize your Chrome tabs any more: every tab keeps its real size.
  • For people developing UseMac: Debug capture (Settings → General → Developer) lets agents take screenshots of UseMac's own windows. It is off until you turn it on.
  • The preview only shows what is happening: stop and resume from the UseMac menu or with ⌘⇧⎋.
  • A lighter, softer shadow around the preview.

After updating, reload the UseMac Browser Bridge from Settings → Chrome Extension.

This is a beta. Please report problems at github.com/diegosquid/usemac/issues, or ask your agent to prepare a report.

item.title: Version 0.6.0-beta.3
item.description:
What's New in UseMac 0.6.0 Beta 3

  • Ask mode: uploads, page scripts and ⌘/⌃ shortcuts wait for your OK in the live preview.
  • App and site rules in Settings → General keep agents away from the apps and sites you choose. Password managers are blocked by default.
  • Several agents can work at once: each task keeps its own Chrome tabs and windows, and the preview names the agent on each card.
  • The execution mode picker in Settings → Safety is readable, the Setup guide offers the same modes, and the menu bar shows the mode whenever it isn't Autonomous. Agents blocked by the mode are told which one, so they can ask you.
  • Settings → History keeps 30 days on disk, folds repeated entries into one row and marks actions apart from observations.
  • Report a problem from your agent: UseMac prepares a report without your personal data, and you review it before anything goes to GitHub.
  • While an agent works in a Chrome tab you're looking at, the tab shows a border and a Stop button.
  • Settings → Chrome Extension shows each profile's extension version and reloads it for you.
  • A lighter app icon shadow, and many fixes to scrolling, file pickers, tab groups and the live preview.

After updating, reload the UseMac Browser Bridge once in chrome://extensions. From then on, Settings → Chrome Extension can reload it for you.

This is a beta. Please report problems at github.com/diegosquid/usemac/issues, or ask your agent to prepare a report.

item.title: Version 0.6.0-beta.2
item.description:
What's New in UseMac 0.6.0 Beta 2

  • The Chrome tab UseMac works in keeps its real width and no longer flickers while you look at it.
  • The preview never shows another app (such as your own screen) when an agent's activity names no app, and each Chrome tab appears once in the filmstrip.
  • The Resume button in the Stopped pill fits on one line.
  • The Chrome extension reports its real version.

After updating, reload the UseMac Browser Bridge in chrome://extensions so Chrome picks up the new extension.

This is a beta. Please report problems at github.com/diegosquid/usemac/issues.

item.title: Version 0.6.0-beta.1
item.description:
What's New in UseMac 0.6.0 Beta 1

  • Agents work more reliably in the background: stable element ids, steps that find elements by what they are, background scrolling, and file pickers driven without taking focus.
  • Every step now says whether it changed anything, instead of a silent "ok".
  • Real keyboard and mouse input only goes to the app in front, so it can never land in the app you are using.
  • New filmstrip preview: the active tab large, the others as live thumbnails, with a clear cue when another one comes forward.
  • The preview never shows your own Chrome tabs, and Chrome tabs UseMac opened are closed when the task finishes.
  • Chrome Web Store and chrome:// pages are handled with a native fallback.

Turn off Settings > Software Updates > Beta updates to stay on stable releases only.

This is a beta. Please report problems at github.com/diegosquid/usemac/issues.

item.title: Version 0.5.0
item.description:
What's New in UseMac 0.5.0

  • Continuous preview HUD lifecycle (task_start → task_complete) with calm glacier-blue rim and frosted completion overlay.
  • Hybrid on-device Apple Vision OCR + MLX Qwen visual assistant (ask, verify, describe) cutting cloud vision tokens by 97%.
  • Silent background MLX warmup on task_start for sub-second first visual queries.
  • Sparkle 2 update support and a drag-to-Applications DMG.
